A1.justification: Both PDFs describe JanusVLN and retain the same core method and original experiments. All 18 pages of v1 and 25 pages of v2, including their appendices, are readable and support comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original R2R-CE and RxR-CE evaluations, component and training-data ablations, inference measurements, and real-world demonstrations.

after.justification: v2 retains those original results and adds HM3D-OVON evaluation, quantitative robot trials, instruction-based performance analyses, and failure cases.

M1.justification: The Qwen2.5-VL/VGGT architecture, initial/sliding-window memory, feature fusion, and action prediction remain unchanged. Appendix B explains attention and cache operations more explicitly without establishing a revised procedure.

E1.justification: v2 adds HM3D-OVON unseen evaluation, extending coverage to open-vocabulary object-goal navigation beyond the retained R2R-CE and RxR-CE benchmarks. Real-world navigation and the original training datasets were already present in v1.

E2.justification: v2 Table 6 introduces VLFM, DAgRL+OD, and MTU3D as comparators alongside the previously evaluated Uni-NaVid. This is a localized expansion for HM3D-OVON; the original benchmark and encoder-comparison rosters are retained.

E3.justification: New supplementary protocols include 25 real-world instructions with a one-meter stopping criterion, keyword-selected spatial instruction subsets, and 50-word RxR instruction-length bins. The original training budgets, benchmark splits, metrics, and memory settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendices C–E add a real-world spatial-memory ablation, spatial-instruction and instruction-length analyses, failure trajectories, and depth/point-cloud token visualizations. These substantially expand diagnostic evidence beyond the original component, memory-size, fusion, and data ablations, which are retained.

E5.justification: v2 specifies three repetitions per instruction for the new quantitative robot evaluation; v1 provides no corresponding repetition count. Neither version reports confidence intervals or significance tests, and the new performance plots have no error bars.

E6.justification: v2 adds HM3D-OVON results, including JanusVLN SR 44.9 and SPL 31.7, plus robot success rates, spatial-subset and instruction-length trends, and failure findings. The original benchmark scores and ablation values remain unchanged after matching renumbered tables; these are additional findings, not improved same-setting scores.

T1.justification: The task definition and Equations 1–4 are retained. Neither version provides formal theorems or proofs, and the new cache explanation introduces no revised mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract and conclusion retain the claims of dual implicit memory, RGB-only spatial understanding, efficient incremental inference, and state-of-the-art navigation. The rewritten second contribution emphasizes the existing VGGT streaming adaptation without changing the scientific claim.

C2.justification: v2 adds substantive limitations and explanations absent from v1: insufficient recovery experience from DAgger and premature stopping tentatively attributed to VGGT lacking real-world scale. It also interprets the long-instruction performance rebound and spatial-token visualizations, substantially expanding discussion of mechanisms and failure conditions.

D1.justification: Appendix B newly documents alternating frame/global attention, current-frame queries, concatenated historical/current keys and values, and Qwen2.5-VL caching. The original hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, project link, and planned code/weight release remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Citations are extensively added and replaced across Sections 1–3, including additions such as SocialNav, NavForesee, LL3DA, and Fast3R and removals such as CoreInfer and CogVLA. HM3D-OVON comparisons also introduce new literature. The overarching positioning against explicit-memory navigation remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: Most shared prose and the main section sequence are retained. v2 revises one contribution bullet, clarifies caching, adds model-detail and analysis sections to the appendix, and updates author and conference information; it does not extensively rewrite the existing narrative.

P2.justification: v2 adds a detailed cache schematic, three quantitative plots, failure-case and spatial-token figures, and the HM3D-OVON table. Existing displays are retained, with several relocated or renumbered, including v1 Figures 5–7 becoming v2 Figures 11–13.

improvement.justification: The added quantitative robot comparison, cache explanation, and concrete failure analysis improve support and transparency beyond v1's qualitative real-world demonstrations. However, HM3D-OVON settings and subgroup sample sizes remain underspecified, uncertainty is unreported, and Figure 8 plots only SR despite discussing SPL. The additions provide useful but qualified overall gains.
